snippet.title: Farsight - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
You know the house from the eye test? The one on the hill, in the middle of a grassy field. Farsight is a first-person psychological horror game about a twelve-year-old kid taken for a routine eye checkup who finds himself inside the images of the machine. 

Peer through keyholes, watch from a distance with binoculars, and use the FUNTIME-GO camera to see beneath the surface of a place you've somehow always been familiar with.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080520/Farsight/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
